usage: pactkit continuation [-h]
                            {checkpoint,status,verify,resume,events,deny} ...

positional arguments:
  {checkpoint,status,verify,resume,events,deny}
    checkpoint          Write an explicit Act checkpoint
    status              Read-only continuation status
    verify              Read-only continuation verify
    resume              Read-only continuation resume
    events              List a run's append-only event stream
    deny                Record an explicit authorization denial (audit event)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
